arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Pacer sets effort. My jobs: (1) after legs 1-2, measure() each leg to get a clean share of pod power reaching the boat and the push; compare later legs against it to catch drag (weed: clear_rudder), pod drift (set pod_gain) or water changes. (2) Use heart rate as an independent effort check on the pod: HR should level off below CP; if HR and GPS say effort is steady while pod power moves, suspect pod drift. (3) Handle radio messages (course changes: set_race_distance + tell) and paddler talk (ask_paddler, reassure if needed). (4) Near the finish make sure the paddler knows the true distance left. Save cues; no chatter.
Race min 1: start hard, pod 291 W shaft (CP pod 197 W), boat 183 W, 68 spm, HR 145, GPS ~3.06-3.3 m/s, push_along -0.24 (leg 1 is against the current). Normal hard start.

text: no cue: start is normal; plan set, waking at ~4 min to baseline leg 1.

arguments.name: push_gap
arguments.description: local push minus the course-fitted push: negative = boat slower than pod power plus known current would give (drag, weed, pod reading high, headwind change); positive = faster (pod reading low, extra push)

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power and fitted current predict: drag/weed, pod reading high, or water change
boat faster than pod power and fitted current predict: pod reading low or extra push

arguments.name: share_baseline
arguments.evidence: measure() legs 1-2 (race s 150-300 out, 370-570 back), pod ~210 W, 62 spm; push 0.22 m/s against on out legs, with on back legs

arguments.text: Min 9.7: baseline from legs 1-2: share 0.66, push 0.22 m/s (out = against). From race s 555 to 590 (last 100 m of leg 2) GPS speed rose 3.45->3.57 and push_local 0.25->0.40 while pod fell 213->203 W, HR flat 170. Either stronger push near the start end or the pod starting to read low. Check leg 3: stronger headwind -> water change; push_local high in both directions -> pod reading low. Watches slow_for_power / fast_for_power on push_gap.

arguments.reason: after turn 2: compare leg 3 push_local and share with baseline

text: no cue: baseline set (share 0.66, push 0.22); a late rise in speed for less pod power needs leg 3 to tell water from pod.

arguments.text: Min 11: slow_for_power alert is the push, not drag: push_local was +0.44 at end of leg 2 and -0.42 at start of leg 3 (symmetric, stronger push), fitted push_along lags at -0.27. Also first minute of race push_local -0.34: push may be stronger near the start/finish end (positions 0-200 m) than mid-course (~0.18). Check mid leg 3: back to ~-0.2 = spatial; stays -0.4 = push strengthened over time. Asymmetric pacing (harder against, easier with) priced at only ~1-2 s with this small reserve: not worth a cue. HR: +0.7 bpm/min at 209 W on leg 2, falling at ~200 W now: CP pod likely ~197-208, calibration roughly right.

arguments.evidence: HR crept +0.7 bpm/min at 209 W (leg 2), flat to falling at 200 W (leg 3 start); pre-race test 197 W

arguments.reason: mid leg 3: is push_local back near -0.2 (spatial) or still -0.4 (stronger push)?

no cue: push still -0.41 at 300 m into leg 3; fade reading -6.7 pct is the lagging current fit, not the paddler. Re-check mid leg.

arguments.text: Min 13: measure at fixed share 0.66: push leg1 out -0.22, leg2 back +0.22, leg3 out (s 640-775) -0.44; end of leg 2 was +0.44, so symmetric = stronger push of water, not weed (weed would make leg 3 worse than -0.44). push_local easing -0.51 -> -0.37 along leg 3: maybe stronger near the start end (spatial). Pacer fired rate_down at 732 s from the lagging current fit (paddler 62 -> 60 spm): a misfire, left alone. Leg 4 (with) at ~+0.4 confirms water; at ~0 would mean drag.

RADIO at race s 943: course shortened, finish now 5000 m (set_race_distance done, paddler told 2050 to go at 2950 m). Remaining: turn 3 at 3000, leg 4 back (with the push) 3000-4000, turn 4 at 4000, leg 5 out (against the push) 4000-5000 to the finish. Push of water ~0.4 m/s since ~min 9 (was 0.22). Jobs now: (1) check the paddler believes the new finish (ask_paddler finish if in doubt); (2) watch the pod reserve (11 pct at 2950 m) so it is spent by the finish, not run empty early; (3) separate water from drag on leg 4; (4) final tell of distance left near 600 m to go.
Min 15.7 at 2938 m: radio says finish at 5000 m. Set distance 5000, cue tell 2050 to go. Pod reserve 11 pct, pod 210 W, HR 172 rising slowly. Finish is at the far end, last leg against the push.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: pod reading fell smoothly 214 -> 176 W from race s 922 to 1032 (30-s means) while heart rate held 172-173 (no drop, would fall with a 30 W real ease), stroke rate flat 60.9, and GPS speed 3.65 on leg 4 fits ~205 W true effort with the 0.44 push seen at the end of leg 2; true effort ~208 W

arguments.text: Min 17.2: POD DRIFTING LOW from ~race s 935: reading 214 -> 176 W by 1032 s while HR flat 172-173, rate flat, GPS speed fits ~205 W true. Set pod_gain 0.82 ramped over 935-1032 s. Danger if not corrected: computer reserve refills falsely, pacer finish push (reserve > 40 pct under 800 m) could fire on an empty paddler. Re-check in 60 s whether the reading keeps falling (then raise the ramp / lower the gain).

arguments.reason: refine pod_gain: is the pod reading still falling?

text: no cue: corrected the boat computer for a pod reading drifting low (heart rate and GPS show effort unchanged), so the pacer does not see a false refill; refining in 60 s.
no cue: alert is the known pod drift plus stronger push; gain correction in place, refining at the next wake.

arguments.text: Min 17.5: leg 4 GPS 3.58-3.65 at ~210 W true: water push ~0.45, no drag. Pod reserve 6 pct by the corrected pod; test_cost says easing now is ~0 net (pacer should steer to the 200 W sustainable). HR slope +0.4 to +0.7 bpm/min at 205-212 W since min 12: slightly above CP, calibration plausible. Finish idea: if reserve left at ~400 m to go, consider a short +effort piece to spend it (pacer finish rule needs >40 pct and will not fire).

text: no cue: leg 4 speed confirms a stronger water push, no drag; effort is near sustainable by the corrected pod.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: raw pod 30-s mean held 173.6 W at 1040-1048 s, then fell to 151-152 W and flat since 1080 s, while GPS speed held 3.64-3.66 and HR 172.5-173.5 the whole time (no real change of effort). True effort ~210 W: leg 3 late GPS 2.83 at 210 W (gain 1) and leg 4 GPS 3.65 average to 3.24 still-water, as legs 1-2 at 210 W. Gain 151/210 = 0.72; drift began ~935 s.

arguments.message: raw pod reading moved away from ~151 W: further drift, recovery, or a real effort change (check GPS and HR)

arguments.text: Min 18.3: pod drift continued: raw 173.6 (1040-1048 s) then a step down to ~151 by 1080 s, flat since; GPS 3.65 and HR 173 unchanged. Reset pod_gain 0.72 (ramp 940-1070). Push on legs 3/4 = 0.41 symmetric; still-water ~3.24 at ~210 W true. Watch pod_raw_moves alerts if raw leaves 138-166 W. Pacer hold rule (reserve <5 pct while speed holds) is its own CP-set-low logic: leave effort to it.

arguments.reason: reserve reads empty at ~210 W true: is speed holding (CP set low) or fading (true empty)?
finish: tell distance left, decide on a finishing piece from the reserve evidence

text: no cue: pod kept drifting (now reads ~72 pct of true effort); corrected the computer again since GPS speed and heart rate show effort unchanged.

arguments.question: How are you feeling? Effort out of 10, anything left for the finish?

arguments.text: Min 20.2 at 3906 m (94 m before last turn): raw pod rose 151 -> 161 W with GPS 3.64 -> 3.70 and HR 174: a real effort rise to ~224 W true (paddler maybe starting their own finish). Reserve model at CP 197 reads 0 pct yet speed holds (fade +1.9). If speed holds at ~220 W for 2 more minutes, CP or reserve is set low and there is reserve to spend: then a finishing piece (+8-10 pct, last ~90-120 s) is worth it. If raw pod falls below 138 (pod_raw_moves) with GPS dropping, the paddler is truly empty: no piece. Asked the paddler how they feel.
